text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan went to watch the Takarazuka 
Kinen, her long-held wish. Gaaah~~! Opera 
O-san and Doto-san are even more precious 
than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the two declare each other 
rivals. Is the reason this scene feels so 
remarkably intense because it's a fated 
showdown? Or could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The answer can surely only be found out on 
the track. Next time: <Onward to the Japan 
Dirt Derby>
